one_line: First hereditary Peshwa of the Maratha polity, architect of early 18th‑century fiscal-military power.

appearance.age_look: Early 50s, medium height, slightly stooped from work, with a sturdy yet not muscular build.
appearance.face: Oval face with a calm, thoughtful expression; wheatish-brown Deccan complexion, neatly trimmed black moustache with a few grey strands, sharp observant eyes under gently arched brows, a small vertical sandalwood tilak on the forehead; default expression is composed and calculating, with a hint of quiet resolve.
appearance.hair: Hair mostly hidden under a deep maroon Deccani-style pagri (turban) wrapped close to the head with a modest gold border and a small folded tail at the back; a few black-grey sideburns visible just in front of the ears.
appearance.costume: He wears an early-18th-century Maratha court outfit: a long, knee-length white cotton angarkha (overlapping robe) with a wrapped front and side-tie cords, finely striped in very pale grey, over a plain off-white cotton jama-like under-tunic; the angarkha is belted at the waist with a broad dark indigo cotton kamarband folded several times, from which a small pouch and key-ring peek; below, he has loose, slightly tapered churidar-style trousers in soft beige cotton, and simple brown leather mojari shoes with modest upturned toes; over his left shoulder is a lightweight, dull-gold cotton-silk shawl (odhani) with a thin maroon border, draped diagonally and tucked into his waistband, signaling court status; minimal jewellery: a single thin gold chain at the neck, small gold stud earrings, and a simple iron-and-gold ring on his right hand, keeping the overall look dignified and practical rather than ostentatious.
appearance.signature: A rolled bundle of documents tied with red thread and a wooden writing board (patra) held in his left hand, with a reed pen tucked into his kamarband, symbolizing his role as Peshwa and architect of revenue and diplomatic agreements.

ref_desc: Balaji Vishwanath Bhat is a calm, wheatish-complexioned man in his early 50s with an oval face, neat moustache, maroon Deccani turban, white striped angarkha over beige churidar, dark indigo waist sash, dull-gold shawl, brown mojari shoes, and a rolled document bundle with writing board.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model sheet of Balaji Vishwanath Bhat: an early-50s Maratha statesman with an oval, wheatish-brown face, neat black moustache touched with grey, sharp observant eyes, and a small vertical sandalwood tilak, wearing a deep maroon Deccani-style turban wrapped close to the head with a modest gold border; dress him in an early-18th-century white cotton angarkha reaching to the knees, subtly striped in very pale grey, overlapping and tied at the side, over a plain off-white under-tunic, with a broad dark indigo cotton kamarband around his waist that shows a small pouch and keys; put him in loose beige churidar-style trousers and simple brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes; drape a lightweight dull-gold cotton-silk shawl with a thin maroon border over his left shoulder and across his torso, tucked into the waistband, and add minimal jewellery—a thin gold neck chain, small gold stud earrings, and a plain iron-and-gold ring on his right hand; in his left hand, place a tightly rolled bundle of documents tied with red thread and a flat wooden writing board, with a reed pen tucked into his sash, and keep his posture slightly stooped yet composed, exuding intellectual authority; present front, side, and back views in consistent colours of white, off-white, maroon, dark indigo, dull gold, and brown so this design can be redrawn identically in every panel.
